knowledge:
- key_parameters: method=Specifies the PCA algorithm to use ("svd", "ppca", "bpca", "svdImpute", "nipals", "nlpca", "robustPca") ;; nPcs=Number of principal components to calculate ;; center=Logical indicating whether to mean-center the data (often set to FALSE if data is pre-scaled/centered using prep()) ;; scale=Scaling method in prep() ("none", "uv", "pareto") ;; maxSteps=Maximum number of iterations for non-linear PCA ("nlpca") ;; fold=Number of folds for cross-validation in Q2()
- alternatives: Standard R prcomp or svd (susceptible to outliers and cannot handle missing values natively) ;; robustPca / robustSvd (preferred when data contains extreme outliers) ;; ppca or bpca (preferred when data contains missing values, with bpca often being more stable than ppca)
- when_to_use: When performing PCA on high-dimensional biological data (e.g., metabolomics, microarrays) that contains missing values (NAs) or extreme outliers, or when missing value imputation is required prior to downstream analysis.
- pitfalls: Standard SVD is highly susceptible to outliers; a single outlier can distort the leading PC. ;; PPCA can be unstable and fail to converge or misestimate values in rare cases (a workaround is shown using a loop to re-run Q2 if values exceed 1). ;; Mean-centering should be done before creating or handling artificial outliers to avoid shifting the original means. ;; Setting obvious outliers to NA and then using an incomplete-data PCA method (like PPCA) is recommended if missingness is < 10%.

workflows.name: pca_and_imputation
workflows.intent: Perform PCA on a matrix containing missing values and impute the missing values to obtain a complete dataset.
input: metaboliteData (matrix containing missing values represented as NA)
workflows.stages: 1. Run PCA using a method that handles missing values (e.g., PPCA) ;; 2. Impute missing values using completeObs
workflows.code:
library(pcaMethods)
data(metaboliteData)
mD <- metaboliteData
pc <- pca(mD, nPcs=3, method="ppca")
imputed <- completeObs(pc)

workflows.name: robust_pca_outliers
workflows.intent: Perform PCA on data containing extreme outliers using robust SVD or by setting outliers to NA and running PPCA.
input: metaboliteDataComplete (complete matrix to which outliers are artificially introduced)
workflows.stages: 1. Pre-center the data ;; 2. Run standard SVD PCA, robust PCA, and PPCA (with outliers set to NA) for comparison ;; 3. Extract loadings to evaluate robustness
workflows.code:
library(pcaMethods)
data(metaboliteDataComplete)
mdc          <- scale(metaboliteDataComplete, center=TRUE, scale=FALSE)
cond         <- runif(length(mdc)) < 0.05
mdcOut       <- mdc
mdcOut[cond] <- 10
resSvd       <- pca(mdc, method="svd", nPcs=5, center=FALSE)
resSvdOut    <- pca(mdcOut, method="svd", nPcs=5, center=FALSE)
resRobSvd    <- pca(mdcOut, method="robustPca", nPcs=5, center=FALSE)
mdcNa        <- mdc
mdcNa[cond]  <- NA
resPPCA      <- pca(mdcNa, method="ppca", nPcs=5, center=FALSE)

workflows.name: expressionset_pca_imputation
workflows.intent: Perform PCA and impute missing values directly on a Bioconductor ExpressionSet object.
input: sample.ExpressionSet (ExpressionSet object containing gene expression data)
workflows.stages: 1. Introduce missing values to the ExpressionSet ;; 2. Run PCA on the ExpressionSet ;; 3. Convert the PCA result back to an imputed ExpressionSet using asExprSet
workflows.code:
library(pcaMethods)
library(Biobase)
data(sample.ExpressionSet)
exSet <- sample.ExpressionSet
exSetNa <- exSet
exprs(exSetNa)[sample(13000, 200)] <- NA
lost <- is.na(exprs(exSetNa))
pc <- pca(exSetNa, nPcs=2, method="ppca")
impExSet <- asExprSet(pc, exSetNa)

workflows.name: pca_diagnostics_validation
workflows.intent: Evaluate PCA model quality using Q2 cross-validation and estimate the optimal number of PCs.
input: metaboliteDataComplete (complete matrix used as reference for validation)
workflows.stages: 1. Preprocess and center the data ;; 2. Run PCA using PPCA and SVD-Impute ;; 3. Calculate Q2 cross-validation scores ;; 4. Estimate the optimal number of PCs using kEstimate
workflows.code:
library(pcaMethods)
data(metaboliteData)
data(metaboliteDataComplete)
md  <- prep(metaboliteData, scale="none", center=TRUE)
mdC  <- prep(metaboliteDataComplete, scale="none", center=TRUE)
resPPCA  <- pca(md, method="ppca", center=FALSE, nPcs=5)
resSVDI  <- pca(md, method="svdImpute", center=FALSE, nPcs=5)
q2SVDI <- Q2(resSVDI, mdC, fold=10)
q2PPCA <- Q2(resPPCA, mdC, fold=10)
while( sum((abs(q2PPCA)) > 1) >= 1 ) {
    q2PPCA <- Q2(resPPCA, mdC, fold=10)
}
errEsti <- kEstimate(md, method = "ppca", evalPcs=1:5, nruncv=1, em="nrmsep")
